correctness.rationale: For every poset, Stanley's canonical order-polytope triangulation yields volume e(P)/n!, coordinate facet total area 2nV, and a cover-contract facet has area √2 e(P/uv)/(n-1)!; the √2 factor is the Euclidean Jacobian of coordinate duplication. In rooted trees, the hook formula e(T)=n!/∏s_u implies cover adjacency probabilities p_uv obey p_root->v=s_v/(n-1) and flow p_v->z/p_u->v=s_z/(s_v-1). Consequently their total equals E depth of the size-biased child walk, proving the exact S/V formula for all finite trees. Positive leaf probabilities give equal-depth rigidity and star/chain extremes. A deepest nonroot internal vertex yields E D≥1+2/(n-1) for nonstar, attained only by one subdivision; consecutive incomparable pairs in extensions yield E D≤n-2 for nonchain with terminal cherry equality. Independently constructed 1,440 rooted labeled trees through n=6 and verified exact rational hook-probability versus size-biased-walk equality. All statements are in standard Euclidean, not lattice boundary normalization.
